description: Whether over-the-air updates are set up on this branch, the update URL the app reads, and the newest release per platform and channel. Set it up with capabilities.add slot ota (or `scribase ota setup`); publish with the unmodified hot-updater CLI (`npx hot-updater deploy -p ios`). Scope: functions:read.

organization_id.description: Organization id. Optional: defaults to the token's organization, or the only one you belong to.

project_id.description: Project id. Optional: defaults to the project created or used last in this session, or the only one.

name: ota.status
title: OTA update status
